resourcePolicy.ordinaryRenderSamples: Last renderer.info.render totals; may include shadow passes.
resourcePolicy.sceneGeometry: All attached streamed and permanent mesh geometry; not a visibility count.
resourcePolicy.sharedImageEstimate: Active shared glTF image textures, RGBA plus mipmaps. Excludes HDR/PMREM, shadow/render targets and runtime-generated textures.
resourcePolicy.combinedTextureEstimate: Shared scene images plus actor/contact textures and allocated lighting targets, including cached PMREM/workspace/fallback/shadow targets. Depth24 is conservatively estimated at 4 bytes per pixel. Excludes driver padding/metadata, canvas/compositor, geometry and temporary conversion peaks.
resourcePolicy.primaryProof: A new real Look closer frame at the same stopped, settled pose; unchanged shadow invalidation counter and no pending light shadow updates before or after.
